messages:
lucy_s: ping team — Polaris AI wants to POC polaris-neo-48b:zlq in Dedicated and Private. asks: is zlq in our catalog, BYOW (bring-your-own-weights) support for private, KMS/EKM + FIPS, KV-cache memory behavior, multi-region routing, and a POC price estimate. can someone take?

omar: whos the contact and whats the expected workload?

lucy_s: contact is rachel@polaris.ai. workload = high-throughput retrieval-augmented generation + nightly batch indexing; contexts ~10k for RAG, lots of short concurrent chats. they also require EU data residency and FIPS-certified KMS for keys.

kevin_ops: zlq is our new low-bit layout (zigzag quant). we haven't had many external requests. i'll run a compatibility scan against a100-80 Dedicated and an onprem VM to cover Private. starting now.

presales-bot: scan started: job=polaris_zlq_scan_44. checks: kv-cache, kernel-compat, tokenization, byow, multi-region routing. ETA ~6m.

omar: quick note on BYOW: for Private we can accept customer weights if they sign the BYOW addendum; need legal + security signoff for handling.

kevin_ops: scan complete. job=polaris_zlq_scan_44. summary: 
- Dedicated (a100-80): kernel patch required for zlq packing (shim available), KV-cache overhead +13%, p99 latency +6% on heavy KV reuse.
- Private (onprem): runtime v2.9+ required for zlq; memory overhead similar.
- BYOW path: allowed on Private only; requires integrity checksum verification and license attestation.
artifact: https://s3.redwood.ai/presales/polaris_zlq_scan_44/report.html

sec-bot: security flags: Polaris requests FIPS KMS + EKM (Gemalto). draft Q entry: "Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS providers; FIPS-certified KMS and external HSM/EKM require ops coordination and an acceptance test plan. BYOW allowed for Private with verification steps."

lucy_s: Rachel also asked about multi-region routing (EU-only). can we pin their Dedicated pool to EU and ensure routing policy prevents US fallback?

kevin_ops: yes — routing policy can pin to eu-west regions and disallow cross-region fallback. for Dedicated we provision a eu-only pool. for Private they'd host in EU infra so fine. ops items: kernel patch, region pool, EKM runbook.

omar: pricing questions: what's rough delta for zlq vs fp16 on Dedicated, and any extra for FIPS/EKM or BYOW handling?

kevin_ops: estimate: zlq runtime compute -22% vs fp16, but KV-cache retention in fp16 adds ~+13% infra memory. FIPS/EKM adds a one-time ops integration + validation fee (coordination with Gemalto), BYOW on Private adds a one-time verification fee and extra 1-2 days of attestation. I'll send rough numbers.

legal-bot: BYOW addendum draft needed: we require license attestation, no redistribution, and liability limits. also confirm export control for model weights; if weights are US-origin might trigger export paperwork for delivery to EU (we'll check).

sec-bot: also note they asked for 24h key rotation and session-level envelope encryption. those increase validation steps; add +1 day for rotation tests.

kevin_ops: minimal repro for tokenization edge-case discovered in scan (small). dropping it here so Polaris can test locally:

```
# repro snippet for token drift (~0.12%)
Prompt: "Summarize: \"User note: 'Send report @ 09:00 \ud83d\ude4c'\" with nested quotes and time zone offsets"
```

kevin_ops: reproduces a 1-token shift in ~0.12% of samples on zlq packing. I have a patch branch ready (rt/polaris/zlq-token-fix) if they need exact parity pre-POC.

lucy_s: ok assigning: kevin = ops scan follow-up + kernel patch plan + quote sketch, omar = BYOW/quote + customer comms, legal-bot = BYOW addendum draft + export check, sec-bot = FIPS/EKM validation text. I'll email Rachel with the report link and draft timelines.

omar: timeline question — if Polaris wants EU-only Dedicated + EKM (Gemalto) + BYOW for Private, how long till we can start POC?

kevin_ops: estimate: Dedicated EU pool config + kernel patch + ops validation = 3 business days. Gemalto EKM integration + rotation tests = 3-6 business days depending on vendor SLAs. BYOW verification for Private = 2-4 business days (checksum + license checks). End-to-end if they want all items: plan ~7-10 business days.

lucy_s: pricing: please give a two-line POC quote (Dedicated compute with zlq runtime delta, one-time FIPS/EKM integration fee) and a separate BYOW verification fee for Private. aim to send by EOD tomorrow.

legal-bot: noted, I'll produce BYOW addendum and a short export control checklist for Rachel.

sec-bot: will finalize FIPS/EKM blurb and acceptance test plan notes.

kevin_ops: will also include recommended fallback policy: route to polaris-neo-12b:fp16 for memory/latency spikes, start with 5% canary.

lucy_s: perfect. I'll reach out to Rachel now with scan link and preliminary timelines. reopening if they ask for more tests. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
